reference: Kerrigan from StarCraft (the 'Queen of Blades'), in Spooked (S8E5). Dwight first insists to Kelly/Ryan he is Kerrigan and blames Toby (presumably Andy's costume pre-screening forced him to drop parts of it); Kelly calls him a 'Jamaican zombie woman', Dwight repeats that line to Bert, and when Bert says he'd look like Kerrigan with bladed wings, Dwight admits 'I AM Kerrigan from Starcraft! I've been censored.'

evidence.line: Kelly: What are you, some kind of Jamaican zombie woman? ... Ryan: Whoopi Goldberg. Dwight: Has no one here heard of Kerrigan, from Starcraft? Queen of blades? It's all Toby's fault.

Dwight: I'm a Jamaican zombie woman, leave me alone, ghoul. Bert: If you had some really big wings with blades on the end, you'd kind of look like Kerrigan from Starcraft. Dwight: Damnit. I AM Kerrigan from Starcraft! I've been censored.
Dwight: Kerrigan is ruler of the Zerg swarm!

caveats: The 'Jamaican zombie woman' label is Kelly's (sc.12); Dwight adopts it as a brush-off. Why the costume was 'censored' (wings removed) is implied, not shown explicitly in the lines (Andy pre-screens costumes, sc.3; Dwight blames Toby). Sc.51 repeats the 'Jamaican zombie woman' exchange with Bert but moves to Walking Dead talk (likely a deleted/alternate scene).
question: At the Halloween party, Dwight says he is a Jamaican zombie woman. Which character does he admit his costume really is?
